name: Blistering Invective
summary: Demoralize nearby enemies with a tirade that burns those it affects.
description: Make an Intimidate check to demoralize the enemies within 30 feet that hear the tirade. Each enemy demoralized by the spell takes 1d10 fire damage and attempts a Reflex save to avoid catching fire. Spell resistance can stop the spell’s fire damage while still allowing the demoralizing effect.
